question: Can pdfrum 0.5.3 with default features disabled safely implement the current 2 MiB input/text and ten-second shared knowledge reader without silent incomplete extraction?
decision: Reject the in-process facade route. No PDF parser dependency is selected or linked; PDF remains required implementation work.

findings.observed: The content tokenizer appends literal and hexadecimal string bytes only while their length is below the fixed 32767-byte maximum. The remaining bytes are consumed without a diagnostic.
findings.impact: A string larger than 32767 bytes can return incomplete text while the diagnostics gate remains empty. This fails the complete-or-error ingestion contract even when memory/time limits are set.
findings.evidence_kind: source inspection; not an executed exploit

findings.observed: The high source code of bfrange is replaced by its low byte combined with the leading bytes of the low source code. A cross-block range can commit a shortened mapping without recording a diagnostic.
findings.impact: Diagnostics cannot by themselves identify every incomplete or unsupported ToUnicode range. Cueglint would need a strict prevalidated CMap profile, independent of any memory isolation.
findings.evidence_kind: source inspection; not a claim about general ISO conformance

findings.observed: An incremented multi-character bfrange clones a destination vector for each code within a maximum 256-code range. The per-block array length check follows construction. Destination vectors and accumulated maps have no caller-controlled cumulative byte/deadline budget.
findings.impact: A per-decoded-stream cap and compact scalar ranges do not establish an adequate total memory or work bound for fonts.
findings.evidence_kind: source inspection; no measured peak memory

findings.observed: parse_content builds an operator vector before the interpreter checks its deadline. Text extraction checks its deadline only on entry and then walks/clones runs and emits text without a caller-controlled output or work cap.
findings.impact: The outer 10-second/2-MiB check can occur after expensive work or allocation. Cooperative interpreter checks do not bound these phases.
findings.evidence_kind: source inspection; no runtime timing claim

findings.observed: The object store retains parsed objects and decoded object-stream containers. The font cache retains loaded fonts by object reference. No cumulative byte budget or maximum-cache-size control was found on these facade paths.
findings.impact: Per-stream, per-array, nesting and xref caps cannot be represented as an already-proven total allocation budget.
findings.evidence_kind: bounded path audit; no assertion that every upstream path is unsafe

findings.observed: The sink stores up to4096 entries and counts dropped entries; extend copies stored entries and does not carry the dropped counter. All facade diagnostics can reject any retained repair, but this does not detect intentionally silent truncation.
findings.impact: Reject all repairs/limit exits, including saturation, if a future adapter uses this library. Do not treat an empty diagnostic set as evidence of complete extraction.

facade_proposal.status: rejected for current shared in-process reader

dependency_constraints.resolver_status: Unrun. Versions may coexist where Cargo permits; no workspace pin changes or Cargo resolution attempted.

required_next_work: Review one constrained native Rust PDF text profile or one native child-process contract with actual platform hard memory/time limits; neither a thread timeout nor a hosted/external PDF command qualifies.

A constrained profile must validate all syntax and mappings before committing text, reject unsupported/encrypted/scanned or exhausted documents visibly, and cap total decoded bytes, parsed nodes, mapping expansion, operations, nesting and text before allocating/emitting.
Reuse read_document(&Path,&AtomicBool) in CLI and desktop; preserve the current2MiB input/text,10s budget, unchanged store schema, single worker/result slot and final cancellation/stale checks.

Before promotion, exercise original multipage/Unicode fixtures and malformed/encrypted/scanned/expansion/cycle/nesting/cancellation/deadline cases, then verify retrieval byte offsets, deletion/invalidation and backup/user-note preservation.
Run affected tests, cargo fmt --check and cargo xtask progress --check only after a limited Cargo/build lease is granted. Keep all unrun, failed and blocked states visible.

source_interpretation_corrections.prior_interpretation: The initial review described long content strings as ordinary/valid and cross-block ranges as incomplete without a normative qualification.

checked_primary_references.observed: PDF 1.7 lists a32767-byte architectural limit for content-stream strings; other strings have no effective restriction.
Incrementing a destination past its final byte is undefined. Cross-leading-source-byte ranges require separate normative review.

source_interpretation_corrections.corrected_conclusion: The source still silently truncates out-of-profile input rather than rejecting it. This is a Cueglint complete-or-error contract concern, not an established ISO conformance defect in pdfrum. No claim that the audited cross-block case is a valid portable PDF is made.
